title: Wedding RSVP Portal
shortDescription: Developed and deployed an online RSVP platform serving 200+ guests with automated attendance management and backup infrastructure

overview: Developed an online RSVP platform serving 200+ guests
Automated 130+ confirmation and attendance-update emails using Python
Deployed the application on a LAMP stack running on a Raspberry Pi
Configured port forwarding to provide external access to the application
Built an AWS Lightsail backup environment to minimize downtime during server failures

title: Autonomous 3D Ballistic Targeting System
shortDescription: Developed an autonomous targeting system that converts 3D target coordinates into launcher angles and flywheel speeds for ping-pong ball targeting

overview: Converted 3D target coordinates into flywheel speeds and dual-axis angles
Achieved 65% targeting accuracy at distances of 6m to 15m
Designed 18 custom mechanical components and integrated 13 electrical components
Simulated up to 1,000 shots before firing to validate targeting accuracy
Developed a Python visualization tool to analyze projectile trajectories
Executed target-to-shot cycles within 7 seconds of receiving coordinates

title: PONG Console System
shortDescription: Built a C++/Arduino PONG console with custom controllers, a 6x6 LED matrix, shift registers, and real-time game logic

overview: Designed two controllers and a 6x6 LED matrix for an Arduino-based PONG console
Implemented real-time game logic to process player input every frame
Integrated two shift registers to control the LED matrix display
Implemented dynamic screen-size handling for different LED matrix configurations
Built responsive input processing for two-player gameplay

title: Physics Collision Engine
shortDescription: Developed a 2D physics engine that simulates elastic collisions between 20+ customizable objects

overview: Derived and implemented 10 physics equations to simulate 2D elastic collisions
Supported 20+ simultaneous objects with customizable mass, velocity, and position
Designed randomized collision experiments to evaluate simulated behavior
Used the engine during physics tutoring sessions to demonstrate elastic-collision concepts

title: TCP Chat Room Server
shortDescription: Engineered a TCP chat server supporting 20+ simultaneous users with direct messaging, activity logging, and custom commands

overview: Engineered a TCP chat server supporting 20+ simultaneous users
Implemented custom nicknames and direct messaging between users
Built queue-based activity logging for user auditing and server-side event tracking
Implemented seven server commands with custom terminal color mapping
